caption: The drawing depicts an aged, tan sheet of paper with ornate calligraphic text written in black ink at the center. The paper is bordered on the left and right sides by vertical arrangements of colorful flowers and greenery. On each side, the floral border consists of pale pink roses at the lower corners, with green leaves and stems extending upward. Above the roses on both sides are three-lobed blue and purple flowers, and above them are additional stems featuring small, light pink flowers with yellow centers and buds. At the top corners, there are more small pink flower buds, and two straight green lines extend inward along the top edge. The corners of the paper are slightly curled and exhibit some discoloration typical of aging. The background is a cream color, and the bottom right corner outside the aged paper is labeled with the text "JERRY GUNITA." The overall composition is framed such that the decorative elements surround the calligraphic passage in the middle.
title: Zoar Decorated Painting
